name: Inverse Gaussian Splattling
aliases: Inverse Gaussian Splattling — Back-projection of 2D Gaussians, Inverse splatting
definition: A process to project 2D Gaussian primitives from image space into world space using rendered depth maps and camera parameters, implemented in three steps to ensure accurate projection.
summary: Inverse Gaussian Splattling initializes 3D Gaussians by back-projecting 2D kernels using weighted PCA and scaling calibration to resolve foreground-background ambiguity.
